content.text:
Plan submitted — all 18 rules searched and one plan filed per rule.

Highlights for the reviewing team:

- **Likely absent (no usable clause found):** MFN, NOSOLICIT, LD, MINCOMMIT. RENEWAL is structurally inapplicable (term runs to expiry of payment/Royalty Term, no renewal mechanic).
- **Present and substantive:** indemnification (14.1–14.3), limitation of liability (14.5), insurance (14.6), governing law and arbitration (15.5 and the dispute-resolution provisions), assignment/change of control (15.2), licence grant (Art. III), IP ownership (10.1), audit (9.8–9.9), warranties (Art. XIII incl. the 13.5 disclaimer), and post-termination transition (12.3).
- **Points worth close reading:** the arbitral seat and rules are redacted, so the GOVLAW forum test cannot be resolved from snippets; the Competing Product termination right at 12.2(d) operates as a de facto restriction on our freedom to operate and should be assessed under NONCOMPETE rather than duplicated under EXCLUSIVITY; the exclusive licence at 3.1 runs in our favour and should not be flagged; and RevMed's reps are given as of the Execution Date only, which bears on the WARRANTY analysis.
